settings.title: Settings
settings.showInFilesNote: The Reverie folder appears in the Files app. Anyone with the phone can copy the files.
settings.faceIdUnavailable: Face ID or a device passcode isn't set up on this device
settings.biometricsUnavailable: No fingerprint, face or screen lock is set up on this device
lock.title: Reverie is locked
settings.privateButtonNote: The eye icon in a chat's header: ask the model about the chat aside, without the characters hearing
settings.suggestButtonNote: The model suggests your reply in the message field. Swipe right to use it, left to dismiss
settings.limitsNote: For moving avatars and pictures in messages (GIF, animated WebP)
settings.recentPicturesNote: A row of your latest pictures in the attach menu
appIcon.hint: The standard icon follows the light and dark look.
chatPreview.reply:
She set the cup down and smiled. *The candle had burned low.*

“Quiet, mostly. I kept thinking you would come back.”
settings.continueButtonNote: The latest chat or scene on the home tabs. Swipe left to hide it
settings.baseUrlHint: Tailscale or local network address, without /v1
settings.apiKeyHint: LM Studio, llama.cpp and Ollama usually don't check the key
settings.contextMessagesWarning: More than 1000 messages will hardly fit in the model's context. The server may return an error or silently cut off the start of the history, replies get slower, and requests and memory use grow a lot. Keep this number within the window the model is loaded with
settings.contextMessagesHint: How many of the latest messages go to the model. Chats and rooms have their own number
settings.contextHint: Set it to what the model is loaded with. When the history no longer fits, the oldest messages are left out
settings.folderSyncSyncNote: Your data lives in a folder you pick (iCloud Drive, Google Drive or on the device), and your other devices read it from there. The API key stays on the device
settings.folderSyncNoFolder: The folder can't be reached anymore. Pick it again
settings.backupNote: Characters, rooms, chats and pictures in one zip. The API key is not saved
settings.dangerNote: Deletes characters, chats, avatars and the server address. Can't be undone
settings.wipeConfirmMessage: Characters, chats, avatars and the server address will be gone for good

promptGen.title: System prompt generator
promptGen.hint: Who they are, temperament, setting, how they treat the user. A couple of sentences is enough
promptGen.placeholder: A cynical starship mechanic who hides a soft heart and speaks in short, dry sentences...
promptGen.empty: The model returned an empty response. Try again
promptGen.changesPlaceholder: E.g. make him grumpier, add a fear of heights. You can leave this empty
promptGen.improveHint: With no requests the AI fills gaps, removes contradictions and makes the character livelier
promptGen.idea1.title: Herbalist
promptGen.idea1: A wandering herbalist from a northern village, calm and observant, speaks in proverbs and distrusts city folk
promptGen.idea2.title: Noir detective
promptGen.idea2: A tired private eye from a rainy 1940s city, cynical and vivid in speech, but always sides with the underdog
promptGen.idea3.title: Ship AI
promptGen.idea3: The onboard AI of a long-haul cargo ship, polite to the point of pedantry, secretly missing the crew who have been in cryosleep for years
promptGen.idea4.title: Language tutor
promptGen.idea4: A friendly Spanish tutor who gently corrects mistakes, explains with examples from movies and loves a good joke
promptGen.revisePlaceholder: What should change in this version?
promptGen.tweakShorter.note: make the prompt noticeably shorter, keeping what matters most
promptGen.tweakLonger.note: add more detail: background, habits, concrete traits
promptGen.tweakSpeech.note: add a few characteristic sample lines of the character's speech
promptGen.tweakVivid.note: make the character bolder and more unusual, drop generic traits

room.castHint: Swipe left to walk a character out of the scene or back in. Press and hold to add another addressee and for more.

roomEditor.perceptionHint: The chance to overhear a whisper meant for someone else
roomEditor.triggersHint: Topics, comma-separated. Hearing them, the character is more eager to cut in
roomEditor.presentNote: Turn off to keep the character away for now: they neither hear nor speak. You can bring them in right from the chat
roomEditor.mutedNote: Hears everything, but speaks only when you ask
roomEditor.maxChainHint: How many characters may speak in a row before it is your turn again
roomEditor.directorNote: When it is unclear who answers, the model decides with a short separate request. The director also follows who comes and goes: characters leave the scene by themselves, throw each other out and let each other in, and your narrator can take anyone out or bring them in. A bit slower, but livelier
